name: Izayoi no Fortuna
original_name: 十六夜のフォルトゥーナ
source:
Kaoru left home and travelled across Japan from place to place due to some circumstances. When he arrived at the small town of Gojou, situated between the sea and mountains, he collapsed due to the intense heat and was taken in by the resident sister Lucia. He decided to stay a while in the town to repay her kindness. Afterwards, his cousin Otome appeared, having followed him all the way to this town, and he also met the mysterious twins Kona and Shigure. He had always been searching for how to use his freedom after having broken away from the bonds of destiny. Are all these chance happenings the work of goddess of fate?

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/11/01/november-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
薰因某些原因離家出走，開始走遍日本各地。抵達位於海山之間的小鎮五條後，他因酷熱難耐而昏倒，被當地居民露西亞修女收留。為了報答她的好意，他決定在鎮上暫住一段時間。後來，表妹乙女一路追隨他來到這裡；他還遇見了神秘的雙胞胎女孩小菜與時雨。掙脫命運束縛後，他一直在尋找該如何運用這份自由。這一連串的偶然邂逅，難道都是命運女神的安排？

［引自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/11/01/november-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]］
